rows.14:13208:
"Kiiiiiiieee!"
The doll let out an anguished shriek, and then it stopped moving.
A spinal cord, just like a human's, had come slithering out with the head I'd yanked off.
And it was still twitching.
The yellow-green slime that had coated the doll's surface melted and ran down {f:my|my} shoulders.
Something like human nerves clung to its skin.{p}
rows.14:13dec:
He came over to me and muttered with a sigh.
"...So, how'd it go? You find Arai?"
He asked it with a serious face.
(Shindo too...?
Shindo couldn't find him either?)
I honestly shook my head.
"...I see. C'mere a sec."
He grabbed my sleeve and dragged me off.{p}
rows.14:13f14: "Hey, what is it? Let me in on it too!"{p}
rows.14:13f4c:
Shindo led me into the shadow of a pillar.
Then he started talking in a low voice.
It seemed to be something it would be bad for anyone to overhear.
"Looks like there's no such guy as Shoji Arai in the second year at our school."
Shindo's words completely crushed my faint hope.
"...Yesterday, after all that, it was bugging me, so I looked into a bunch of stuff.
And guess what.
That doll story he told looks like it might actually be true.
Apparently, every single year, one person always ends up as the victim and dies.{p}
rows.14:14b14:
"Two of the people from that meeting are dead.
That leaves me, you, Iwashita, Kazama, and Arai.
But Arai's not at this school."
He had the face of someone holding back terror.
"I figured Hosoda was this year's victim......"
Shindo murmured it under his breath.
We didn't know what we should do, and for a while we just stood there, frozen.{p}
